Or upload Zendesk files

Already have offline exports? Pack local ticket, user, organization, comment and history files with supplied attachments, then upload them here. Saved replies (macros) and configuration can be uploaded too, each a line like {"macro":{...}}; the Zendesk section of the Move in guide shows a complete example of each.

Export file

Each file can be up to 2 MiB. A file we can’t read completely is refused before anything is saved, with the file, line and field to fix. Export files stay private to you.
